```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("fig.Resultants.liner")
source("scripts/fig/Resultants.R")
PLOT <- buildCalculationResultantsInteractive(
  pathCurves = Calculation$paths$resultants,
  pathScales = Calculation$paths$scales,
  radius = Calculation$geometry$radiusM,
  graphicAmplification = Calculation$display$graphicAmplification,
  raysPerCircle = Calculation$display$raysPerCircle,
  scaleMode = "local-by-lining-and-resultant"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-resultants-liner
#| fig-cap: !expr CAP
#| echo: false
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-align: center
PLOT
```

```{r}

rm(CAP, PLOT, buildCalculationResultantsInteractive)
```
